description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillDecorator class, which provides methods to modify EmployeeSkill objects, including associating them with Employee and Skill entities via their IDs. It serves as a decorator to enhance or modify EmployeeSkill behavior within the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for EmployeeSkill entities, providing methods to associate employee and skill data by their identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSkill instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the EmployeeSkill based on employee number.

methods.name: setSkillBySkillId
methods.description: Associates a Skill entity with the EmployeeSkill based on skill ID.
